The '''Bakura Trace''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the route was little-used.

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] made use of the path to send a task force from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] in response to a request for help from Governor [[Wilek Nereus]].<ref name="TABS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
